description: This file implements a text-to-speech (TTS) service class `GroqTTSService` that integrates with Groq's TTS API. It defines an inner class for input parameters, initializes the service with parameters like API key, voice, model, and format, and provides an asynchronous method to generate speech frames from text input. It also handles external dependencies and logging.

classes.name: GroqTTSService
classes.description: A service class that provides text-to-speech synthesis utilizing Groq's TTS API, supporting configurable voices, models, and formats.

methods.name: bool can_generate_metrics(self)
methods.description: Indicates that this TTS service supports metrics generation.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator[Frame,None] run_tts(self, text: str)
methods.description: Asynchronously generates speech frames from input text using Groq's TTS API, yielding raw audio data frames or error/stopped frames.
